profile_text.body:
Cerence Inc. is a public company headquartered in Burlington, Massachusetts, traded under the ticker CRNC. On its own site, the company describes itself as delivering conversational and agentic AI-powered user experiences for automotive and beyond, and as providing "the trusted interaction and action layer for physical AI." It says its platform combines voice, multimodal understanding, contextual intelligence, agentic architecture, and governed execution to help people communicate with vehicles, machines, and intelligent systems.

The site names several offerings. Cerence xUI is described as a multimodal AI foundation that helps OEMs combine speech, vision, and vehicle data to understand driver intent. Cerence Emergency Vehicle Detection (EVD) is described as deployed in production vehicles, able to detect and localize more than 1,500 emergency sirens across nearly 50 countries, identifying approaching emergency vehicles from more than 300 meters away with interior microphones and beyond 800 meters with exterior microphones. The site also describes dynamic speech enhancement for multi-seat in-car environments, work with Microsoft on Zero Trust and layered AI security for in-car assistants, and a Q&A on North American OEMs moving toward scalable, embedded in-car AI platforms. The company states its technology has been developed and deployed at automotive scale.

The site also reports third quarter results: revenue up 12% year over year, connected services revenue up 20% year over year, and operating cash flow of $20M supporting a first-ever share repurchase program. No lawsuits, MCP servers, or tracked products are recorded for the company.
